notes.author: human:pioootrek
notes.text: Preserve the read-only hub boundary. The selected handoff must not give the deployed hub repository write credentials.

problem: Instruction Explorer can export a checked patch, but handing that patch to a GitHub-backed project still requires a manual transfer outside the product flow.

risk.rollback: Disable the GitHub-specific handoff and retain the existing copy, download, and git apply workflow.

scope: Choose and document a GitHub handoff that keeps repository mutation outside the deployed hub, then implement the smallest static-browser flow needed to initiate it.
Carry the immutable base commit and source hash through the handoff, and keep stale-base checks visible to the receiving workflow.
title: Add a read-only GitHub handoff for instruction patches
validation: An end-to-end fixture exports a proposal, initiates the selected GitHub handoff, and proves that the hub process holds no repository write token.
Stale base metadata, oversized content, and malformed targets are rejected or shown as explicit blocking states.
value: A reviewed browser draft can enter the normal GitHub workflow without copying an untraceable patch between tools.
